Due to infrastructure limitations, no direct transit route exists between Warehouse Alpha and Warehouse Beta.
Furthermore, operational logistics dictate that precisely one of the following two major corridors must be incorporated into the circuit: the route connecting Warehouse Beta and Warehouse Gamma, or the route connecting Warehouse Gamma and Warehouse Delta.

The objective is to determine the inspection circuit of minimal total travel distance that visits each warehouse exactly once before concluding at the point of origin.
